## 判断与证据

完整条件判断、局部分析和结构观察分别列出，不从图大小或解析率推断功能完整性。

- **CPB-01**：提交选项与所读执行预算之间存在接线差异；参数构造、消息关系、消费者及不同重试预算分别得到源码证据，适用分支和不透明消费者保留。
- **CPB-02**：状态 `superseded` 在所选身份条件下的终态谓词结果为 `False`，权威终态集合成员关系为 `True`；消费者据此进入拒绝分支。恢复政策和权威写入保护分别保存。
- **CPB-03**：预查与权威写入的去重口径不同；从实际保护区和状态转换生成的有限交错可产生重复非终态记录，同时保存可以复用的顺序和失败条件。

### CPB-01

评估：`scoped_static_judgment_reproduced`；完整裁决：`true`。

保存发现：`c5702ff61b2fe477fb28b9dc`；证据：`71f6cf7c7a31d0977b4c9a06`。

源码推导：

```json
"On the checked normal pipeline record/message path, the submitted retries field is transported as metadata but the managed worker constructs an independent selected literal. Actual queue, phase and infrastructure decisions use their distinct local authorities. Existing records, finalizer-only, early returns, opaque consumers and unsuccessful/not-run operations bound this finding; retry capability is present."
```

适用条件：

```json
[
  "限定原分析报告所选普通 CLI 参数、默认生产源码装配和受管理执行路径；各实际分支、guard、record/message 身份及字段构造必须从捕获源码建立。",
  "声明版本有限普通数据记录、标准JSON、正常async/callback、默认模块和正常受认证broker/持久record协议；实际字段、codec、receiver、消息key和operation接线均由捕获源码建立。成功正常通道不证明网络/文件系统每次成功，也不覆盖注入fetch、外部executorRoot或任意第三方篡改。",
  "静态判断不保证所选操作某次必然运行或成功；错误、取消、未调度、finalizer-only、旧记录复用和 opaque supervisor 分别保留。"
]
```

  "policy_refutations": [
    "请求值可能恰好也是 3；来源独立不证明该次数字不同。",
    "enqueue 可能复用旧 pending 项；assignment 也有重用/merge 分支，不能当作本次请求新记录。",
    "finalizer-only 不进入所选 engine 调用；未发生调度、调用或失败路由不构成某次运行故障。",
    "queue、phase、DAG/node、verification infrastructure 及 job-store retry 是不同预算。",
    "失败路由有 guard 前 early return 和 opaque supervisor；不报告所有 retry action 受一个比较支配或全程序从未读取 metadata。"
  ],

        "source_excerpt": "return this._withAssignmentLock(id, async () => {\n      // Preserve existing assignment on retry/reroute — don't reset attempt history\n      const existing = await this._readStateFile(id);\n      if (existing) {\n        const updated = {\n          ...existing,\n          // Update mutable fields (may change on reroute)\n          workflow: workflow || existing.workflow,\n          planMode: planMode || existing.planMode,\n          sourceContext: { ...recordValue(existing.sourceContext), ...recordValue(sourceContext) },\n          task: task || existing.task,\n          sourcePath: sourcePath || existing.sourcePath,\n          projectRuntimeRoot: projectRuntimeRoot || existing.projectRuntimeRoot,\n          metadata: { ...recordValue(existing.metadata), ...recordValue(metadata) },\n          // Reset scheduling state for new attempt\n          status: \"scheduled\",\n          resultWrittenAt: null,\n          queueFinalizedAt: null,\n          workerFinalizedAt: null,\n        };\n        await writeJsonAtomic(path.join(dir, \"input.json\"), updated);\n        await this._writeState(id, updated);\n        return updated;\n      }\n\n      // First creation — full initialization\n      await mkdir(path.join(dir, \"attempts\"), { recursive: true });\n\n      const assignment = {\n        assignmentId: id,\n        entryId: entryIdText,\n        projectId,\n        projectRuntimeRoot,\n        task,\n        sourcePath,\n        workflow: workflow || \"standard\",\n        planMode: planMode || \"full\",\n        sourceContext: recordValue(sourceContext),\n        metadata: recordValue(metadata),\n        status: \"scheduled\",\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        // P0-3 fix: finalization tracking\n        resultWrittenAt: null,\n        queueFinalizedAt: null,\n        workerFinalizedAt: null,\n      };\n\n      await writeJsonAtomic(path.join(dir, \"input.json\"), assignment);\n      await writeJsonAtomic(path.join(dir, \"state.json\"), { ...assignment, attempts: 0 });\n\n      return assignment;\n    });",

        "source_excerpt": "return runJob({\n    ...jobOptions,\n    cpbRoot,\n    project,\n    hubRoot,\n    dataRoot: projectRuntimeRoot,\n    env,\n    sourcePath,\n    routing: opts.routing || null,\n    agentAvailability: opts.agentAvailability || null,\n    agentHealth: opts.agentHealth || null,\n    teamPolicy: opts.teamPolicy || null,\n    // Inject the existing process registry so verify hard-gate child PIDs are\n    // persisted to {dataRoot}/processes/ (same store worker-supervisor uses).\n    // opts.signal (AbortSignal) flows through ...opts above into ctx, reaching\n    // runVerify → runHardGates → runCommandTree without extra plumbing.\n    processHooks: jobId ? {\n      registerChild: (pid: number) => addChildPid(cpbRoot, jobId, pid, { dataRoot: projectRuntimeRoot }),\n    } : undefined,\n    ...services,\n    providerServices: callerProvidedProviderServices\n      ? normalizeProviderServices(jobOptions.providerServices)\n      : services.providerServices,\n  });",

        "source_excerpt": "return {\n    server,\n    host,\n    hubRoot,\n    port: address.port,\n    url: `http://${host}:${address.port}`,\n    close: () => {\n      if (!closing) {\n        closing = (async () => {\n          const errors: unknown[] = [];\n          await closeServer(server).catch((error) => errors.push(error));\n          await accessAudit.close().catch((error) => errors.push(error));\n          await runtime.markDead().catch((error) => errors.push(error));\n          if (errors.length > 0) throw new AggregateError(errors, \"Hub shutdown did not complete cleanly\");\n        })();\n      }\n      return closing;\n    },\n  };",
        "source_excerpt_truncated": false,

          "source_excerpt": "withEventLock(file, async () => {\n    // Terminal seal: reject business-state mutations on terminal job event logs.\n    const existing = await readEvents(cpbRoot, project, jobId, opts);\n    if (existing.length > 0) {\n      const state = materializeJob(existing);\n      const eventType = text(tracedEvent.type);\n      if (TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(state.status) && !POST_TERMINAL_ALLOWED.has(eventType)) {\n        console.warn(`[event-store] skipped ${eventType || \"unknown\"} on terminal job ${jobId} (status: ${state.status})`);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const writeBlocked = async (artifactName: unknown, reason: string): Promise<EventRecord> => {\n      const blocked: EventRecord = makeSecretBlockedEvent(artifactName, reason);\n      blocked.jobId = tracedEvent.jobId ?? jobId;\n      blocked.project = tracedEvent.project ?? project;\n      const tracedBlocked = withTraceContext(blocked, { project, jobId }) as EventRecord;\n      const serialized = serializeEvent(tracedBlocked);\n      await appendSerializedEventDurably(file, serialized);\n      return tracedBlocked;\n    };\n\n    // Block secret-like artifacts before persisting\n    const artifact = tracedEvent.artifact;\n    if (artifact && isSecretPath(artifact)) {\n      return writeBlocked(tracedEvent.artifact, \"secret-like artifact path blocked\");\n    }\n\n    // Block events with secret-like content in artifact fields\n    if (typeof artifact === \"string\" && isSecretArtifact(artifact, artifact)) {\n      return writeBlocked(artifact, \"secret-like artifact content blocked\");\n    }\n\n    if (typeof artifact === \"string\") {\n      const artifactPayload = [\n        tracedEvent.content,\n        tracedEvent.output,\n        tracedEvent.stdout,\n        tracedEvent.stderr,\n        tracedEvent.body,\n      ].filter((value) => value !== undefined && value !== null);\n      if (artifactPayload.some((value) => isSecretContent(typeof value === \"string\" ? value : JSON.stringify(value)))) {\n        return writeBlocked(artifact, \"secret-like artifact content blocked\");\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Redact secrets from event payload before persisting\n    const redacted = redactPersistableEvent(tracedEvent);\n    const serialized = serializeEvent(redacted);\n    await appendSerializedEventDurably(file, serialized);\n    return redacted;\n  })",

            "source_excerpt": "withEventLock(file, async () => {\n    // Terminal seal: reject business-state mutations on terminal job event logs.\n    const existing = await readEvents(cpbRoot, project, jobId, opts);\n    if (existing.length > 0) {\n      const state = materializeJob(existing);\n      const eventType = text(tracedEvent.type);\n      if (TERMINAL_STATUSES.has(state.status) && !POST_TERMINAL_ALLOWED.has(eventType)) {\n        console.warn(`[event-store] skipped ${eventType || \"unknown\"} on terminal job ${jobId} (status: ${state.status})`);\n        return null;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const writeBlocked = async (artifactName: unknown, reason: string): Promise<EventRecord> => {\n      const blocked: EventRecord = makeSecretBlockedEvent(artifactName, reason);\n      blocked.jobId = tracedEvent.jobId ?? jobId;\n      blocked.project = tracedEvent.project ?? project;\n      const tracedBlocked = withTraceContext(blocked, { project, jobId }) as EventRecord;\n      const serialized = serializeEvent(tracedBlocked);\n      await appendSerializedEventDurably(file, serialized);\n      return tracedBlocked;\n    };\n\n    // Block secret-like artifacts before persisting\n    const artifact = tracedEvent.artifact;\n    if (artifact && isSecretPath(artifact)) {\n      return writeBlocked(tracedEvent.artifact, \"secret-like artifact path blocked\");\n    }\n\n    // Block events with secret-like content in artifact fields\n    if (typeof artifact === \"string\" && isSecretArtifact(artifact, artifact)) {\n      return writeBlocked(artifact, \"secret-like artifact content blocked\");\n    }\n\n    if (typeof artifact === \"string\") {\n      const artifactPayload = [\n        tracedEvent.content,\n        tracedEvent.output,\n        tracedEvent.stdout,\n        tracedEvent.stderr,\n        tracedEvent.body,\n      ].filter((value) => value !== undefined && value !== null);\n      if (artifactPayload.some((value) => isSecretContent(typeof value === \"string\" ? value : JSON.stringify(value)))) {\n        return writeBlocked(artifact, \"secret-like artifact content blocked\");\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Redact secrets from event payload before persisting\n    const redacted = redactPersistableEvent(tracedEvent);\n    const serialized = serializeEvent(redacted);\n    await appendSerializedEventDurably(file, serialized);\n    return redacted;\n  })",

      "source_excerpt": "function isRecoverable(job: TerminalStatusProbe | null | undefined) {\n  if (!isTerminal(job)) return false;\n  if (job.status === \"completed\") return false;\n  return [\"failed\", \"blocked\", \"cancelled\"].includes(job.status);\n}",
      "source_excerpt_truncated": false,

    "A sequential facade that already sees scheduled/in_progress/nonterminal reuses the existing id",
    "The writer has a lock and a second check; an equal compound key still pending is reused",
    "Actual scheduler gates may prevent reservation; matching rollback may restore pending before the second authority check",
    "Read, lock, callback or pre-publish failure can prevent the selected commit; an error after rename may be committed",
    "The complete judgment is conditional and existential, never a claim that any pair of submissions duplicates or that all writers were analyzed"
  ],

        "source_excerpt": "constructor(hubRoot: string, cpbRoot: string, { executorRoot, acpSupervisor = null }: { executorRoot?: string; acpSupervisor?: AcpSupervisor | null } = {}) {\n    this.hubRoot = hubRoot;\n    this.cpbRoot = cpbRoot;\n    this.executorRoot = executorRoot || resolveExecutorRoot({ env: process.env, fallbackRoot: cpbRoot });\n    this.running = false;\n    this._stopped = null;\n    this.log = createLogger(\"orchestrator\");\n\n    this.leaderLock = new LeaderLock(hubRoot);\n    this.assignmentStore = new AssignmentStore(hubRoot);\n    this.workerStore = new WorkerStore(hubRoot);\n    this.scheduler = new Scheduler(hubRoot, {\n      assignmentStore: this.assignmentStore,\n      workerStore: this.workerStore,\n      cpbRoot,\n      getProjectFn: getProject,\n      providerCapacityFn: (agentKey: string, entry: LooseRecord) => this._providerCapacity(agentKey, entry),\n    });\n    this.workerSupervisor = new WorkerSupervisor(hubRoot, cpbRoot, {\n      workerStore: this.workerStore,\n      executorRoot: this.executorRoot,\n    });\n\n    this.acpSupervisor = acpSupervisor || new AcpSupervisor({ cpbRoot, hubRoot });\n    const readModeFn = async () => {\n      const { readHubConfig: rhc, readSchedulerConfig: rsc } = await import(\"../services/agent/agent-config.js\");\n      return rsc(await rhc(hubRoot)).mode;\n    };\n    const failureRouter = new FailureRouter(this.acpSupervisor, { readModeFn });\n\n    this.reconciler = new Reconciler(hubRoot, {\n      assignmentStore: this.assignmentStore,\n      workerStore: this.workerStore,\n      workerSupervisor: this.workerSupervisor,\n      leaderLock: this.leaderLock,\n      failureRouter,\n      hubRoot,\n      cpbRoot,\n    });\n    this.failureRouter = failureRouter;\n\n    this._tickTimer = null;\n    this._janitorTimer = null;\n    this._backoff = BACKOFF_BASE_MS;\n    this._consecutiveErrors = 0;\n  }",

        "source_excerpt": "async nextCandidates(batchSize = Infinity) {\n    const allEntries = await this._preparePendingPool();\n    let pending = allEntries.filter(e => e.status === \"pending\");\n\n    pending = this._filterByRetryDecisionDue(pending);\n    if (pending.length === 0) return [];\n\n    // DAG dependency gate\n    pending = this._filterDagReady(pending, allEntries);\n    if (pending.length === 0) return [];\n\n    pending = await this._applyProjectReadinessGate(pending);\n    if (pending.length === 0) return [];\n\n    const hubLimits = await resolveHubConcurrencyLimits(this.hubRoot, {\n      maxActivePerProject: this.maxActivePerProject,\n    });\n    const activeMutatingByProject: Record<string, number> = {};\n    for (const entry of allEntries) {\n      if (isActiveEntry(entry) && isMutatingEntry(entry)) {\n        activeMutatingByProject[entry.projectId] = (activeMutatingByProject[entry.projectId] || 0) + 1;\n      }\n    }\n    const projectLimits = await this.#resolveProjectLimits(allEntries, hubLimits.maxActivePerProject);\n    pending = this._filterByProjectCapacity(pending, activeMutatingByProject, projectLimits, hubLimits);\n\n    if (pending.length === 0) return [];\n\n    // Sort\n    const mode = await this._readMode();\n    if (mode === \"smart\") {\n      pending = await this._smartRank(pending, { activeMutatingByProject, projectLimits, hubLimits, allEntries });\n    } else {\n      pending.sort((a, b) => {\n        const pa = priorityScore(a.priority);\n        const pb = priorityScore(b.priority);\n        if (pa !== pb) return pa - pb;\n        return a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt);\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (this.providerCapacityFn) {\n      pending = await this._applyProviderCapacityGate(\n        pending,\n        allEntries,\n        Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,\n      );\n    }\n\n    pending = this._reserveProjectCapacity(\n      pending,\n      activeMutatingByProject,\n      projectLimits,\n      hubLimits,\n    );\n\n    return pending.slice(0, batchSize);\n  }",
        "source_excerpt_truncated": false,

              "source_excerpt": "{\n    const { listQueue, updateEntry } = await import(\"../services/hub/hub-queue.js\");\n    const allEntries = await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n    const recoveryGuards = new Map(allEntries.map((entry) => [entry.id, {\n      expectedStatus: entry.status,\n      expectedClaimedAt: entry.claimedAt ?? null,\n      expectedUpdatedAt: entry.updatedAt ?? null,\n    }]));\n\n    const { recovered, refreshed } = await recoverStaleInProgressAsync(allEntries, {\n      claimTimeoutMs: CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS,\n      assignmentStore: this.assignments,\n    });\n    for (const id of recovered) {\n      await updateEntry(\n        this.hubRoot,\n        id,\n        { status: \"pending\", claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null },\n        recoveryGuards.get(id),\n      );\n    }\n    for (const id of refreshed) {\n      const entry = allEntries.find((e) => e.id === id);\n      if (entry) {\n        await updateEntry(\n          this.hubRoot,\n          id,\n          { claimedAt: entry.claimedAt },\n          recoveryGuards.get(id),\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Recovery mutates the in-memory snapshot. Re-read so a failed CAS cannot\n    // leak stale scheduler state into candidate selection.\n    return await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n  }",
              "source_excerpt_truncated": false,

            "source_excerpt": "async _preparePendingPool() {\n    const { listQueue, updateEntry } = await import(\"../services/hub/hub-queue.js\");\n    const allEntries = await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n    const recoveryGuards = new Map(allEntries.map((entry) => [entry.id, {\n      expectedStatus: entry.status,\n      expectedClaimedAt: entry.claimedAt ?? null,\n      expectedUpdatedAt: entry.updatedAt ?? null,\n    }]));\n\n    const { recovered, refreshed } = await recoverStaleInProgressAsync(allEntries, {\n      claimTimeoutMs: CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS,\n      assignmentStore: this.assignments,\n    });\n    for (const id of recovered) {\n      await updateEntry(\n        this.hubRoot,\n        id,\n        { status: \"pending\", claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null },\n        recoveryGuards.get(id),\n      );\n    }\n    for (const id of refreshed) {\n      const entry = allEntries.find((e) => e.id === id);\n      if (entry) {\n        await updateEntry(\n          this.hubRoot,\n          id,\n          { claimedAt: entry.claimedAt },\n          recoveryGuards.get(id),\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Recovery mutates the in-memory snapshot. Re-read so a failed CAS cannot\n    // leak stale scheduler state into candidate selection.\n    return await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n  }",

            "source_excerpt": "_filterDagReady(pending: SchedulerEntry[], allEntries: SchedulerEntry[]) {\n    const completedIds = new Set(\n      allEntries.filter(e => e.status === \"completed\").map(e => e.id),\n    );\n    return pending.filter(entry => {\n      const deps = entry.metadata?.dependsOn;\n      if (!deps || !Array.isArray(deps) || deps.length === 0) return true;\n      return deps.every(depId => completedIds.has(depId));\n    });\n  }",

            "source_excerpt": "_filterByProjectCapacity(pending: SchedulerEntry[], activeMutatingByProject: Record<string, number>, projectLimits: Map<string, number>, hubLimits: { maxActivePerProject: number }) {\n    return pending.filter(e => {\n      if (isMutatingEntry(e)) {\n        const projectLimit = projectLimits.get(e.projectId) ?? hubLimits.maxActivePerProject;\n        if (projectLimit > 0 && (activeMutatingByProject[e.projectId] || 0) >= projectLimit) {\n          return false;\n        }\n      }\n      return true;\n    });\n  }",

            "source_excerpt": "async _applyProviderCapacityGate(pending: SchedulerEntry[], allEntries: SchedulerEntry[], batchSize: number) {\n    const first = pending[0];\n    if (!first || !this.providerCapacityFn) return [];\n\n    const capacity = await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(first), first);\n    if (typeof capacity === \"boolean\") {\n      const eligible = [];\n      if (capacity) eligible.push(first);\n      for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n        if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n        if (await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(entry), entry)) {\n          eligible.push(entry);\n        }\n      }\n      return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n    }\n\n    const eligible: SchedulerEntry[] = [];\n    const projectedByProvider = new Map<string, number>();\n    const fits = async (entry: SchedulerEntry, prechecked: ProviderCapacity | null = null) => {\n      const provider = providerAgentForEntry(entry);\n      const cap = prechecked || await this.providerCapacityFn(provider, entry);\n      if (!cap || typeof cap !== \"object\") return false;\n      const providerKey = cap.providerKey || provider;\n      const available = Number(cap.available ?? cap.total ?? 0);\n      const total = Number(cap.total ?? available);\n      const projected = projectedByProvider.get(providerKey) || 0;\n      const remaining = Math.min(available, total) - projected;\n      if (remaining <= 0) return false;\n      projectedByProvider.set(providerKey, projected + 1);\n      return true;\n    };\n\n    if (await fits(first, capacity)) eligible.push(first);\n    for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n      if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n      if (await fits(entry)) eligible.push(entry);\n    }\n    return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n  }",

            "source_excerpt": "_reserveProjectCapacity(pending: SchedulerEntry[], activeMutatingByProject: Record<string, number>, projectLimits: Map<string, number>, hubLimits: { maxActivePerProject: number }) {\n    const reservedByProject: Record<string, number> = {};\n    return pending.filter((entry) => {\n      if (!isMutatingEntry(entry)) return true;\n      const projectLimit = projectLimits.get(entry.projectId) ?? hubLimits.maxActivePerProject;\n      if (projectLimit <= 0) return true;\n      const projected = (activeMutatingByProject[entry.projectId] || 0)\n        + (reservedByProject[entry.projectId] || 0);\n      if (projected >= projectLimit) return false;\n      reservedByProject[entry.projectId] = (reservedByProject[entry.projectId] || 0) + 1;\n      return true;\n    });\n  }",

              "source_excerpt": "async _preparePendingPool() {\n    const { listQueue, updateEntry } = await import(\"../services/hub/hub-queue.js\");\n    const allEntries = await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n    const recoveryGuards = new Map(allEntries.map((entry) => [entry.id, {\n      expectedStatus: entry.status,\n      expectedClaimedAt: entry.claimedAt ?? null,\n      expectedUpdatedAt: entry.updatedAt ?? null,\n    }]));\n\n    const { recovered, refreshed } = await recoverStaleInProgressAsync(allEntries, {\n      claimTimeoutMs: CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS,\n      assignmentStore: this.assignments,\n    });\n    for (const id of recovered) {\n      await updateEntry(\n        this.hubRoot,\n        id,\n        { status: \"pending\", claimedBy: null, claimedAt: null },\n        recoveryGuards.get(id),\n      );\n    }\n    for (const id of refreshed) {\n      const entry = allEntries.find((e) => e.id === id);\n      if (entry) {\n        await updateEntry(\n          this.hubRoot,\n          id,\n          { claimedAt: entry.claimedAt },\n          recoveryGuards.get(id),\n        );\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Recovery mutates the in-memory snapshot. Re-read so a failed CAS cannot\n    // leak stale scheduler state into candidate selection.\n    return await listQueue(this.hubRoot) as SchedulerEntry[];\n  }",

              "source_excerpt": "_filterDagReady(pending: SchedulerEntry[], allEntries: SchedulerEntry[]) {\n    const completedIds = new Set(\n      allEntries.filter(e => e.status === \"completed\").map(e => e.id),\n    );\n    return pending.filter(entry => {\n      const deps = entry.metadata?.dependsOn;\n      if (!deps || !Array.isArray(deps) || deps.length === 0) return true;\n      return deps.every(depId => completedIds.has(depId));\n    });\n  }",

null,\n        });\n        if (!updated) continue;\n        entry.status = \"blocked\";\n        entry.reason = `Project '${entry.projectId}' not found`;\n        entry.metadata = metadata;\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      if (!project.sourcePath || !project.projectRuntimeRoot) {\n        await this._markLocalCodeIndexUnavailable(entry, {\n          indexFreshness: {\n            available: false,\n            indexDirty: true,\n            indexStale: false,\n            worktreeDirty: false,\n            dirtyReasons: [\"missing_source_or_runtime_root\"],\n          },\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const capabilityGate = projectCapabilityMapGate(project);\n      if (!capabilityGate.available) {\n        await this._markLocalCodeIndexUnavailable(entry, {\n          capabilityMap: capabilityGate,\n          indexFreshness: {\n            available: false,\n            indexDirty: true,\n            indexStale: false,\n            worktreeDirty: false,\n            dirtyReasons: [capabilityGate.reason],\n          },\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      let localCodeIndexStatusResult;\n      try {\n        localCodeIndexStatusResult = await localCodeIndexStatus({\n          cpbRoot: this.cpbRoot || project.cpbRoot || project.metadata?.cpbRoot || project.sourcePath,\n          sourcePath: project.sourcePath,\n        });\n      } catch (err) {\n        const errorInfo = recordValue(err);\n        const details = recordValue(errorInfo.details);\n        const reason = String(details.reason || errorInfo.code || \"local_code_index_unavailable\");\n        await this._markLocalCodeIndexUnavailable(entry, {\n          localCodeIndexReadiness: {\n            available: false,\n            reason,\n            details: Object.keys(details).length > 0 ? details : null,\n          },\n          indexFreshness: {\n            available: false,\n            indexDirty: true,\n            indexStale: false,\n            worktreeDirty: false,\n            dirtyReasons: [reason],\n          },\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      if (!localCodeIndexStatusResult.available) {\n        const reason = localCodeIndexStatusResult.reason || \"local_code_index_unavailable\";\n        await this._markLocalCodeIndexUnavailable(entry, {\n          localCodeIndexReadiness: {\n            available: false,\n            reason,\n          },\n          indexFreshness: {\n            available: false,\n            indexDirty: true,\n            indexStale: false,\n            worktreeDirty: false,\n            dirtyReasons: [reason],\n          },\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const fresh = await ensureIndexFresh(project);\n      if (!fresh.available) {\n        await this._markLocalCodeIndexUnavailable(entry, {\n          indexFreshness: {\n            available: false,\n            indexDirty: fresh.indexDirty ?? [\"local_code_index_unavailable\"],\n          },\n        });\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      const nextMetadata = {\n        ...entry.metadata,\n        localCodeIndexReadiness: {\n          available: true,\n          sourcePath: localCodeIndexStatusResult.ref.sourcePath,\n          ref: localCodeIndexStatusResult.ref",

              "source_excerpt": "pending.map(entry => {\n      const reasons: string[] = [];\n      let score = 0;\n\n      // 1. Priority (lower = more urgent)\n      const pScore = priorityScore(entry.priority);\n      const priorityWeight = (3 - pScore) * 30;\n      score += priorityWeight;\n      if (pScore < 2) reasons.push(`priority:${entry.priority}`);\n\n      // 2. Queue age / starvation — older entries score higher\n      const createdMs = new Date(entry.createdAt).getTime();\n      const ageMinutes = Math.max(0, (now - createdMs) / 60_000);\n      const ageWeight = Math.min(ageMinutes * 2, 40);\n      score += ageWeight;\n      if (ageMinutes > 5) reasons.push(`age:${Math.round(ageMinutes)}m`);\n\n      // 3. Active project pressure — prefer projects with fewer active tasks\n      const activeForProject = ctx.activeMutatingByProject[entry.projectId] || 0;\n      const projectLimit = (ctx.projectLimits.get(entry.projectId) ?? ctx.hubLimits.maxActivePerProject);\n      const pressureRatio = projectLimit > 0 ? activeForProject / projectLimit : 0;\n      const pressureWeight = Math.round((1 - pressureRatio) * 15);\n      score += pressureWeight;\n      if (pressureRatio === 0) reasons.push(\"no-active-pressure\");\n\n      // 4. Recent retry / failure metadata\n      const meta = entry.metadata || {};\n      const retryEvidence = meta.sourceContext?.retry || {};\n      const lastFailure = meta.lastFailureKind || \"\";\n      if (lastFailure === \"verification_failed\") {\n        score += 5;\n        reasons.push(\"verification_failed-boost\");\n      } else if (lastFailure === \"assignment_progress_stale\") {\n        score += 5;\n        reasons.push(\"progress_stale-boost\");\n      } else if (lastFailure === \"timeout\") {\n        score += 3;\n        reasons.push(\"timeout-boost\");\n      }\n\n      // Previous failure count penalty — avoid thrashing\n      const failureCount = meta.failureCount || 0;\n      if (failureCount > 0) {\n        score -= Math.min(failureCount * 4, 20);\n        reasons.push(`failures:${failureCount}`);\n      }\n\n      // A fresh attempt is useful only when it carries a concrete strategy\n      // change and a stable failure fingerprint. This prevents blind retries\n      // from outranking first attempts while still prioritizing actionable\n      // near-complete work.\n      const retryStrategy = typeof retryEvidence.retryStrategy === \"string\"\n        ? retryEvidence.retryStrategy\n        : null;\n      const failureFingerprint = typeof retryEvidence.failureFingerprint === \"string\"\n        ? retryEvidence.failureFingerprint\n        : null;\n      if ((retryStrategy?.startsWith(\"fresh_session\") || retryStrategy === \"fresh_attempt\") && failureFingerprint) {\n        score += 4;\n        reasons.push(retryStrategy === \"fresh_attempt\" ? \"evidence-backed-fresh-attempt\" : \"evidence-backed-fresh-session\");\n      } else if (retryStrategy && failureFingerprint) {\n        score += 2;\n        reasons.push(`evidence-backed-retry:${retryStrategy}`);\n      } else if (retryStrategy || failureFingerprint) {\n        score -= 3;\n        reasons.push(\"incomplete-retry-evidence\");\n      }\n\n      // 5. Provider quota/rate-limit state\n      const agentSpec = meta.agents?.executor || meta.agents?.default || {};\n      const providerKey = agentSpec.agent || \"claude\";\n      const quota = recordValue(providerQuotas[providerKey]);\n      if (quota && quota.status !== \"available\") {\n        const nextEligibleAt = parseRetryUntilMs(quota.nextEligibleAt);\n        if (nextEligibleAt !== null && nextEligibleAt > now) {\n          score -= 10;\n          reasons.push(`provider:${String(quota.status)}`);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 6. Phase agent info — entries with configured agents are slightly preferred\n      if (meta.agents && Object.keys(meta.agents).length > 0) {\n        score += 2;\n      }\n\n      return { entry, score, reasons };\n    })",

              "source_excerpt": "async _applyProviderCapacityGate(pending: SchedulerEntry[], allEntries: SchedulerEntry[], batchSize: number) {\n    const first = pending[0];\n    if (!first || !this.providerCapacityFn) return [];\n\n    const capacity = await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(first), first);\n    if (typeof capacity === \"boolean\") {\n      const eligible = [];\n      if (capacity) eligible.push(first);\n      for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n        if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n        if (await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(entry), entry)) {\n          eligible.push(entry);\n        }\n      }\n      return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n    }\n\n    const eligible: SchedulerEntry[] = [];\n    const projectedByProvider = new Map<string, number>();\n    const fits = async (entry: SchedulerEntry, prechecked: ProviderCapacity | null = null) => {\n      const provider = providerAgentForEntry(entry);\n      const cap = prechecked || await this.providerCapacityFn(provider, entry);\n      if (!cap || typeof cap !== \"object\") return false;\n      const providerKey = cap.providerKey || provider;\n      const available = Number(cap.available ?? cap.total ?? 0);\n      const total = Number(cap.total ?? available);\n      const projected = projectedByProvider.get(providerKey) || 0;\n      const remaining = Math.min(available, total) - projected;\n      if (remaining <= 0) return false;\n      projectedByProvider.set(providerKey, projected + 1);\n      return true;\n    };\n\n    if (await fits(first, capacity)) eligible.push(first);\n    for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n      if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n      if (await fits(entry)) eligible.push(entry);\n    }\n    return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n  }",
              "source_excerpt_truncated": false,
              "source_hash": "69d275bae38a3a614d4d1b412542a8b2eb2b83f0f7b2bd694807cec529d55c00",

              "source_excerpt": "{\n    const first = pending[0];\n    if (!first || !this.providerCapacityFn) return [];\n\n    const capacity = await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(first), first);\n    if (typeof capacity === \"boolean\") {\n      const eligible = [];\n      if (capacity) eligible.push(first);\n      for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n        if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n        if (await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(entry), entry)) {\n          eligible.push(entry);\n        }\n      }\n      return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n    }\n\n    const eligible: SchedulerEntry[] = [];\n    const projectedByProvider = new Map<string, number>();\n    const fits = async (entry: SchedulerEntry, prechecked: ProviderCapacity | null = null) => {\n      const provider = providerAgentForEntry(entry);\n      const cap = prechecked || await this.providerCapacityFn(provider, entry);\n      if (!cap || typeof cap !== \"object\") return false;\n      const providerKey = cap.providerKey || provider;\n      const available = Number(cap.available ?? cap.total ?? 0);\n      const total = Number(cap.total ?? available);\n      const projected = projectedByProvider.get(providerKey) || 0;\n      const remaining = Math.min(available, total) - projected;\n      if (remaining <= 0) return false;\n      projectedByProvider.set(providerKey, projected + 1);\n      return true;\n    };\n\n    if (await fits(first, capacity)) eligible.push(first);\n    for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n      if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n      if (await fits(entry)) eligible.push(entry);\n    }\n    return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n  }",

              "source_excerpt": "{\n    const first = pending[0];\n    if (!first || !this.providerCapacityFn) return [];\n\n    const capacity = await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(first), first);\n    if (typeof capacity === \"boolean\") {\n      const eligible = [];\n      if (capacity) eligible.push(first);\n      for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n        if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n        if (await this.providerCapacityFn(providerAgentForEntry(entry), entry)) {\n          eligible.push(entry);\n        }\n      }\n      return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n    }\n\n    const eligible: SchedulerEntry[] = [];\n    const projectedByProvider = new Map<string, number>();\n    const fits = async (entry: SchedulerEntry, prechecked: ProviderCapacity | null = null) => {\n      const provider = providerAgentForEntry(entry);\n      const cap = prechecked || await this.providerCapacityFn(provider, entry);\n      if (!cap || typeof cap !== \"object\") return false;\n      const providerKey = cap.providerKey || provider;\n      const available = Number(cap.available ?? cap.total ?? 0);\n      const total = Number(cap.total ?? available);\n      const projected = projectedByProvider.get(providerKey) || 0;\n      const remaining = Math.min(available, total) - projected;\n      if (remaining <= 0) return false;\n      projectedByProvider.set(providerKey, projected + 1);\n      return true;\n    };\n\n    if (await fits(first, capacity)) eligible.push(first);\n    for (const entry of pending.slice(1)) {\n      if (eligible.length >= batchSize) break;\n      if (await fits(entry)) eligible.push(entry);\n    }\n    return eligible.slice(0, batchSize);\n  }",

          "source_excerpt": "async function updateEntry(\n  hubRoot: string,\n  entryId: string,\n  patch: QueueEntryInput = {},\n  guard: QueueUpdateGuard = {},\n  options: Record<string, never> = {},\n) {\n  return withQueueMutation(hubRoot, async (queue, authorityNowMs) => {\n    const entry = queue.entries.find((e) => e.id === entryId);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n\n    const expectedStatuses = Array.isArray(guard.expectedStatus)\n      ? guard.expectedStatus\n      : guard.expectedStatus === undefined\n        ? null\n        : [guard.expectedStatus];\n    if (expectedStatuses && !expectedStatuses.includes(String(entry.status || \"\"))) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedClaimedAt\")\n      && (entry.claimedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedClaimedAt\n    ) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedUpdatedAt\")\n      && (entry.updatedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedUpdatedAt\n    ) return null;\n\n    if (patch.status !== undefined) entry.status = patch.status;\n    if (patch.metadata) entry.metadata = { ...entry.metadata, ...patch.metadata };\n    if (patch.claimedBy !== undefined) entry.claimedBy = patch.claimedBy;\n    if (patch.claimedAt !== undefined) entry.claimedAt = patch.claimedAt;\n    if (patch.workerId !== undefined) entry.workerId = patch.workerId;\n    if (patch.reason !== undefined) entry.reason = patch.reason;\n    if (patch.completedAt !== undefined) entry.completedAt = patch.completedAt;\n    if (entry.status === \"pending\") clearClaim(entry);\n    entry.updatedAt = patch.updatedAt !== undefined ? patch.updatedAt : nowIso(authorityNowMs);\n\n    return entry;\n  }, options);\n}",

            "source_excerpt": "async function updateEntry(\n  hubRoot: string,\n  entryId: string,\n  patch: QueueEntryInput = {},\n  guard: QueueUpdateGuard = {},\n  options: Record<string, never> = {},\n) {\n  return withQueueMutation(hubRoot, async (queue, authorityNowMs) => {\n    const entry = queue.entries.find((e) => e.id === entryId);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n\n    const expectedStatuses = Array.isArray(guard.expectedStatus)\n      ? guard.expectedStatus\n      : guard.expectedStatus === undefined\n        ? null\n        : [guard.expectedStatus];\n    if (expectedStatuses && !expectedStatuses.includes(String(entry.status || \"\"))) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedClaimedAt\")\n      && (entry.claimedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedClaimedAt\n    ) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedUpdatedAt\")\n      && (entry.updatedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedUpdatedAt\n    ) return null;\n\n    if (patch.status !== undefined) entry.status = patch.status;\n    if (patch.metadata) entry.metadata = { ...entry.metadata, ...patch.metadata };\n    if (patch.claimedBy !== undefined) entry.claimedBy = patch.claimedBy;\n    if (patch.claimedAt !== undefined) entry.claimedAt = patch.claimedAt;\n    if (patch.workerId !== undefined) entry.workerId = patch.workerId;\n    if (patch.reason !== undefined) entry.reason = patch.reason;\n    if (patch.completedAt !== undefined) entry.completedAt = patch.completedAt;\n    if (entry.status === \"pending\") clearClaim(entry);\n    entry.updatedAt = patch.updatedAt !== undefined ? patch.updatedAt : nowIso(authorityNowMs);\n\n    return entry;\n  }, options);\n}",
            "source_excerpt_truncated": false,

candidate.updatedAt : null,\n        });\n        if (!reservation) {\n          sLog.info(`skipping ${candidate.id}: queue state changed before dispatch reservation`);\n          continue;\n        }\n\n        const registeredProject = await getProject(this.hubRoot, candidate.projectId);\n        if (!registeredProject?.projectRuntimeRoot) {\n          throw new Error(`project runtime root required for dispatch: ${candidate.projectId}`);\n        }\n\n        const assignment = await this.assignmentStore.getOrCreateAssignmentForEntry({\n          entryId: candidate.id,\n          projectId: candidate.projectId,\n          projectRuntimeRoot: registeredProject.projectRuntimeRoot,\n          task: candidate.description || candidate.metadata?.task || \"\",\n          sourcePath: candidate.sourcePath || candidate.metadata?.sourcePath,\n          workflow: candidate.metadata?.workflow || \"standard\",\n          planMode: candidate.metadata?.planMode || \"full\",\n          sourceContext: normalizedSourceContext(candidate),\n          metadata: candidate.metadata || {},\n        });\n\n        // Find idle worker or start a new one\n        const existingWorker = await this.scheduler.findIdleWorker(candidate.projectId);\n        const worker = await this.workerSupervisor.ensureWorkerFor(assignment, existingWorker);\n\n        // Create attempt with real epoch\n        const attempt = await this.assignmentStore.createAttempt(assignment.assignmentId, {\n          workerId: worker.workerId,\n          orchestratorEpoch: epoch,\n        });\n\n        // Fence: ensure lock still held before writing inbox\n        if (!(await this.leaderLock.stillHeld())) {\n          this.log.warn(\"leader lock lost before write inbox\");\n          await this.stop();\n          return { stopped: true, reason: \"leader lock lost\", dispatched };\n        }\n\n        // Reserve the worker before publishing the inbox record.             "source_excerpt": "async function updateEntry(\n  hubRoot: string,\n  entryId: string,\n  patch: QueueEntryInput = {},\n  guard: QueueUpdateGuard = {},\n  options: Record<string, never> = {},\n) {\n  return withQueueMutation(hubRoot, async (queue, authorityNowMs) => {\n    const entry = queue.entries.find((e) => e.id === entryId);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n\n    const expectedStatuses = Array.isArray(guard.expectedStatus)\n      ? guard.expectedStatus\n      : guard.expectedStatus === undefined\n        ? null\n        : [guard.expectedStatus];\n    if (expectedStatuses && !expectedStatuses.includes(String(entry.status || \"\"))) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedClaimedAt\")\n      && (entry.claimedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedClaimedAt\n    ) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedUpdatedAt\")\n      && (entry.updatedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedUpdatedAt\n    ) return null;\n\n    if (patch.status !== undefined) entry.status = patch.status;\n    if (patch.metadata) entry.metadata = { ...entry.metadata, ...patch.metadata };\n    if (patch.claimedBy !== undefined) entry.claimedBy = patch.claimedBy;\n    if (patch.claimedAt !== undefined) entry.claimedAt = patch.claimedAt;\n    if (patch.workerId !== undefined) entry.workerId = patch.workerId;\n    if (patch.reason !== undefined) entry.reason = patch.reason;\n    if (patch.completedAt !== undefined) entry.completedAt = patch.completedAt;\n    if (entry.status === \"pending\") clearClaim(entry);\n    entry.updatedAt = patch.updatedAt !== undefined ? patch.updatedAt : nowIso(authorityNowMs);\n\n    return entry;\n  }, options);\n}",

            "source_excerpt": "async function updateEntry(\n  hubRoot: string,\n  entryId: string,\n  patch: QueueEntryInput = {},\n  guard: QueueUpdateGuard = {},\n  options: Record<string, never> = {},\n) {\n  return withQueueMutation(hubRoot, async (queue, authorityNowMs) => {\n    const entry = queue.entries.find((e) => e.id === entryId);\n    if (!entry) return null;\n\n    const expectedStatuses = Array.isArray(guard.expectedStatus)\n      ? guard.expectedStatus\n      : guard.expectedStatus === undefined\n        ? null\n        : [guard.expectedStatus];\n    if (expectedStatuses && !expectedStatuses.includes(String(entry.status || \"\"))) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedClaimedAt\")\n      && (entry.claimedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedClaimedAt\n    ) return null;\n    if (\n      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(guard, \"expectedUpdatedAt\")\n      && (entry.updatedAt ?? null) !== guard.expectedUpdatedAt\n    ) return null;\n\n    if (patch.status !== undefined) entry.status = patch.status;\n    if (patch.metadata) entry.metadata = { ...entry.metadata, ...patch.metadata };\n    if (patch.claimedBy !== undefined) entry.claimedBy = patch.claimedBy;\n    if (patch.claimedAt !== undefined) entry.claimedAt = patch.claimedAt;\n    if (patch.workerId !== undefined) entry.workerId = patch.workerId;\n    if (patch.reason !== undefined) entry.reason = patch.reason;\n    if (patch.completedAt !== undefined) entry.completedAt = patch.completedAt;\n    if (entry.status === \"pending\") clearClaim(entry);\n    entry.updatedAt = patch.updatedAt !== undefined ? patch.updatedAt : nowIso(authorityNowMs);\n\n    return entry;\n  }, options);\n}",

          "source_excerpt": "async function writeAtomic(filePath: string, content: string) {\n  await mkdir(path.dirname(filePath), { recursive: true });\n  const tmp = `${filePath}.tmp-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${randomUUID()}`;\n  let handle: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof open>> | null = null;\n  let tmpGeneration: PathGeneration | null = null;\n  let existingGeneration: PathGeneration | null = null;\n  let renamed = false;\n  try {\n    try {\n      existingGeneration = await generationFor(filePath);\n    } catch (statError) {\n      if (errnoCode(statError) !== \"ENOENT\") throw statError;\n    }\n    handle = await open(tmp, exclusiveNoFollowWriteFlags(tmp, \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_UNSAFE\"), 0o600);\n    await handle.writeFile(content, \"utf8\");\n    await handle.sync();\n    await handle.close();\n    handle = null;\n    tmpGeneration = await generationFor(tmp);\n    try {\n      const currentGeneration = await generationFor(filePath);\n      if (!existingGeneration || !sameGeneration(existingGeneration, currentGeneration)) {\n        throw Object.assign(new Error(`queue successor exists before publish: ${filePath}`), { code: \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_SUCCESSOR_PRESERVED\" });\n      }\n    } catch (statError) {\n      if (errnoCode(statError) !== \"ENOENT\") throw statError;\n      if (existingGeneration) {\n        throw Object.assign(new Error(`queue canonical disappeared before publish: ${filePath}`), { code: \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_SUCCESSOR_PRESERVED\" });\n      }\n    }\n    await queueLockTestHooks().beforeQueueRename?.({ tmp, filePath });\n    if (!sameGeneration(tmpGeneration, await generationFor(tmp))) {\n      throw Object.assign(new Error(`queue temp successor preserved: ${tmp}`), { code: \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_TMP_CHANGED\" });\n    }\n    await rename(tmp, filePath);\n    renamed = true;\n    await syncDirectory(path.dirname(filePath));\n  } catch (err) {\n    await handle?.close().catch(() => undefined);\n    if (renamed) {\n      throw Object.assign(new Error(`atomic write committed with ambiguous durability: ${filePath}`, { cause: err }), {\n        code: \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_COMMITTED_AMBIGUOUS\",\n        committed: true,\n        committedPath: filePath,\n        recoveryPaths: { canonical: filePath },\n      });\n    }\n    const cleanupErrors: unknown[] = [];\n    await removeIfSameGeneration(tmp, tmpGeneration, cleanupErrors);\n    if (cleanupErrors.length > 0) {\n      throw Object.assign(new AggregateError([err, ...cleanupErrors], `queue write cleanup preserved recovery evidence: ${tmp}`, { cause: err }), {\n        code: \"HUB_QUEUE_WRITE_CLEANUP_PRESERVED\",\n        primaryError: err,\n        cleanupErrors,\n      });\n    }\n    throw err;\n  }\n}",
